marta_mapline: hey @eli_support — finished the Mapline onboarding flow but when we try to call the hosted API the key returns 403. console shows the key in the project UI though. tenant: mapline-prod, project: mapline-prod-01. example call and response below:

marta_mapline: ```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer rk_live_ABC123xyz' \n  -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/completions \n  -d '{"model":"rwdl-4b","input":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  \"error\": \"access_denied\",
  \"message\": \"service account not bound to project\"
}
```

eli_support: thanks — that error usually means the onboarding claim didn't bind the service role to the expected project. can you paste the key id (last 6 chars) and the org tenant id from the console? also any deploy/provision logs if you have them.

marta_mapline: key last6: "ABC123". tenant id from console: `org_mapline_0f2a`. i don't have provision logs, just the UI showing the key under Projects → mapline-prod-01.

prov-bot: [system] claim#2812349987 created for tenant org_mapline_0f2a at 2026-03-16T18:42:13Z. status: queued -> assigned -> bound_to_project: mapline-onboarding-qa (note: assigned project does not match requested project mapline-prod-01). provisioning trace id: trace-9c7a.

sasha_eng: pinging infra, this looks like a routing/label mismatch in the provisioner. @eli_support can you check the internal reconcile job? quick check: `GET /internal/provisioner/trace/trace-9c7a` — should show assigned_project_id.

eli_support: ran the trace query, output: ```json
{
  "trace_id": "trace-9c7a",
  "tenant": "org_mapline_0f2a",
  "requested_project": "mapline-prod-01",
  "assigned_project": "mapline-onboarding-qa",
  "reason": "label:source=onboard-team matched an older org mapping in the staging db"
}
```

eli_support: looks like the provisioner matched an old mapping for that tenant (leftover from an internal test). I'll run a reconcile to rebind the service account to the correct project. doing: `POST /internal/provisioner/reconcile?tenant=org_mapline_0f2a&force=true`

prov-bot: [action] reconcile started for org_mapline_0f2a (initiated by eli_support).

prov-bot: [action] found stray mapping (mapline-onboarding-qa) -> removing; applying binding to mapline-prod-01; creating roleBinding rb-20260316-xyz; applying IAM policy; status: success.

eli_support: reconcile completed, role binding applied. can you try the request again @marta_mapline (may take ~10s to propagate)?

marta_mapline: re-ran the same curl, now HTTP/1.1 200 OK, returning tokens/response. looks good from here. thank you!! :tada:

sasha_eng: filing a small follow-up: add tenant->project mapping cleanup to the provisioner startup, and a one-off migration to remove the staging mapping for org_mapline_0f2a. i'll create a ticket.

eli_support: noted, moved this thread to resolved. closing once customer confirms no further issues.

marta_mapline: confirmed, all good. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
